title: Page 10
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
lines: “都睡在一张床上了，还装什么装。”李大婶对着赵雪可没好脸色，想她将大把银子给了刘彩凤，谁知道媳妇跑了，这几年她可没少被人取笑，这次打定主意一定要将赵雪给带回去。
“那是假的！”赵雪吼道。
卫元召接过来看，上头确实是赵雪的名字，至于是真是假倒是不知，他并没有看过赵雪的字。
此时周屹天在一旁开了口，“原本他们对小丫下药，要坏小丫的名声让她嫁给李虎，是小丫命大逃过一劫，与我进了京，不然如今小丫可就嫁给李虎了。”
卫元召难得听周屹天说这么一长串话，这字字句句令他怒火中烧。
卫阁老和宋氏的脸色也不好。
“是真的。”卫元召将婚书交给李大婶，“既是你李家人，你把人带走吧。”
李大婶一乐，拉着李虎站起身。
赵雪颤抖的看着两人靠近，正要逃，却被李大婶一把捉住。“你这个贱蹄子，现在还想跑！”
“媳妇儿、媳妇儿。”李虎拉着赵雪傻乎乎的叫着。
赵雪惊慌失措的看向赵小丫，“小丫，救我！”
赵小丫有些惊讶她竟还厚着脸皮向自己求助，轻轻的反问一句，“当初你不救我，如今我为何要救你？”
赵雪心底一凉，想要挣扎，但是李大婶的力气比她大得多，狠狠的一巴掌打得她耳朵嗡嗡作响，痛得她差点晕过去。
“顾良。”
在门外的顾良上前，“侯爷。”
“就当本侯爷赏赐，送他们回去。”周屹天的口气没有半点温度。
顾良知道周屹天的言下之意是不想再看见赵雪出现在眼前，立刻称是，转身出去。
“我的闺女，你受难了。”宋氏摸了摸赵小丫的脸，满脸的心疼。
自己确实受难了，可是看着宋氏，赵小丫却什么都不想再说。
说到底，宋氏心里该是比她更难受。
宋氏抱着她，内心一阵痛苦与不舍，连忙拉着赵小丫的手，“都这个时辰了还未传膳，你该是饿了。”
赵小丫还未开口，周屹天已经先答了句，“我们在侯府用过了。”
宋氏微愣了下。
赵小丫无奈的看了周屹天一眼，柔声对宋氏说道：“确实用过了，不过还是可以陪娘和爹吃一点。”
宋氏激动的和卫阁老对视了一眼，嘴里直说着好闺女，连忙吩咐下人摆膳。
卫元召听到赵小丫叫爹娘，心里也是一阵激动，“小丫，我是哥哥。”
周屹天面无表情的看着卫元召。
卫元召故意视而不见，期盼的看着赵小丫。
赵小丫的求生本能向来挺好的，她已经不顾周屹天的意愿留在卫府用膳，再叫卫元召一声哥哥，只怕倒楣的不单是自己，卫元召也不会好过。
“兄长。”她不亲不疏的叫了一声。
卫元召虽不满意，但也只能勉强接受，他不悦的目光对上周屹天，“你急着娶小丫为妻，就是怕我们卫家跟你抢人，你真的不是人。”
周屹天的回应只是高傲的扫了他一眼，半点不见心虚。
卫阁老也品出了点道理，恨恨的看着周屹天，他的闺女没在家中住过一日，就成别人家的了。
察觉了卫阁老愤愤的眼神，周屹天只是唤了一声，“岳丈。”
卫阁老气得一口老血梗在喉中。
周屹天扬了下唇角，卫阁老虽不古板，但毕竟有文人作风，他很清楚自己肯定不会是卫家老俩口心目中的女婿选择，只能先下手为强。
用完膳，在宋氏不舍，卫阁老、卫元召愤愤的目光下，周屹天直接带走了人家的闺女。
毕竟闺女如今已成亲，是周家人了，纵是不甘，也只能认了。
尾声 善恶终有报
周屹天在卫元召与永乐郡主成亲后便押粮离京，回漠北。
送走周屹天后，赵小丫还是心软，去了趟卫府，开口替赵老爹求情。
赵老爹被送离京城，离去那日得了一笔赵小丫派人送来的银两，让他哭得老泪纵横。
刘彩凤最终受了笞刑，还未受完便已没了声息。
赵雪被带回光州的路上不甘心的逃了一次，被李大婶抓回来狠狠的打了一顿，足足躺了三日，醒了之后竟双耳失聪。
赵雪再不甘，如今也只能乖乖的留在李家过日子。
她并不知自己因失聪一事，令周屹天改了主意，侥幸的留了一命。
卫府未将此事牵扯上卫昭同，卫阁老还是依原意让他回护卫营磨练。
卫昭同一听，立刻气得找上卫老夫人，谁知面对的却是卫老夫人的一阵咒骂，平白无故帮人家养了孩子，这对她而言是极大的耻辱。
卫昭同看着卫老夫人的嘴脸，一时气愤，转身离家，直到这个时候他都还没觉悟自己已经不是卫家二公子了。
卫阁老平空多出了个闺女一事终归没瞒住，恶毒易子一事瞬间传遍了京城。
平时与卫昭同称兄道弟的人一下子全都消失，卫昭同离了卫府，日日藉酒消愁，只觉得一日他喝得醉醺醺，摇摇晃晃的走在街上，迷糊间看到侯府的马车，忙大叫，“赵小丫，你给我滚下来！”
坐在马车里的赵小丫原不想理会，但卫昭同不顾死活的硬是挡在车前，此匆马车在石桥之上，进退两难，逼得她下了马车。
赵小丫看着四周，有片刻的失神，她也曾经走上这座桥，但最终……
她看向卫昭同，她已不同，而他呢？还会选择上辈子的路吗？
“二爷拦路，不知所为何事？”
赵小丫一声二爷如同一根针，直刺卫昭同的心窝，令他疼痛难以忍受，“赵小丫，不，我现在不该叫你赵小丫，应该叫你卫煦。煦，暖也，你是卫家的太阳，我则是卫家的渣滓。你肯定很得意，作梦都会笑醒吧！本是个下贱胚子，如今却摇身一变成了京城贵女。”
“二爷醉了。”赵小丫没有看他，移步走到桥边，低头看着底下的流水，“回吧。”
卫昭同涨红了脸，这段日子的失意，从云端掉落至尘土中，全都是因为她。若是没有她，他还是卫阁老的次子，卫府的二爷。
他猛然对她伸出手，往她的背后一推。
赵小丫早有防备，往旁边一闪。
卫昭同没料到她会闪躲，自己落入水中。
杏儿的心跳漏了一拍，连忙走到赵小丫的身旁。若是夫人掉入水中有万一，她只能拿命跟侯爷交代。
赵小丫看着在水面浮沉挣扎的卫昭同，眼底闪过杀意，就在善恶一念间，终究唤了口
气，没制止马夫下去救人。
赵小丫头也不回的上了马车，派人送卫昭同去医馆，至于日后人是死是活，与她无说。
远在漠北的周屹天看着面前的沙盘，听着顾良说话。
“如今卫昭同落水受了风寒未癒，租了间破屋子住着。”
周屹天面无表情，将自己手中都护府的红旗插上关外铁勒部落，淡淡丢了一句，“既是病了，就让他好好病着。”
顾良明白这句话背后的含意，领命退了出去。
周屹天的目光停在一旁书案上的信，想起赵小丫的笑容，眼中隐隐有了愧疚之意。
快了！他在心中喃道：我必凯旋，你安心等我。
隔月，大军直入铁勒部落，部落降。
历时年余，漠北十三部归顺，周屹天率领军队凯旋返京。
赵小丫看到入门熟悉的高大身影，露出一抹他熟悉的笑。
他看进了她的眼里，“我回来了。”
她奔进他的怀里，他伸手紧拥住她。
一眼万年，终此一生缠绕他的心，非她莫属。
content_en:
"We are all sleeping on the same bed, why are we pretending?" Aunt Li had a bad look towards Zhao Xue, thinking that she had given a lot of money to Liu Caifeng, but who knew that her daughter-in-law had run away. She had been teased a lot in the past few years, and this time she made up her mind to take Zhao Xue back.
"That's false!" Zhao Xue shouted.
Wei Yuanzhao took it and looked at it. It was indeed Zhao Xue's name. He didn't know whether it was true or not. He had never read Zhao Xue's name.
At this time, Zhou Yitian spoke at the side, "Originally, they drugged Xiaoya to ruin Xiaoya's reputation and make her marry Li Hu. But Xiaoya escaped with her life and went to Beijing with me. Otherwise, Xiaoya would have married Li Hu now."
It was rare for Wei Yuanzhao to hear such a long string of words from Zhou Yitian, and every word made him furious.
Elder Wei Ge and Mrs. Song also looked bad.
"It's true." Wei Yuanzhao handed the marriage certificate to Aunt Li, "Since it's your Li family, you can take her away."
Aunt Li was happy and pulled Li Hu to stand up.
Zhao Xue trembled as she watched the two approaching. She was about to run away, but was caught by Aunt Li. "You bastard, you still want to run away!"
"Daughter-in-law, daughter-in-law." Li Hu pulled Zhao Xue and shouted stupidly.
Zhao Xue looked at Zhao Xiaoya in panic, "Xiaoya, help me!"
Zhao Xiaoya was a little surprised that she had the audacity to ask him for help, and asked softly, "You didn't save me back then, why should I save you now?"
Zhao Xue felt cold in her heart and wanted to struggle, but Aunt Li was much stronger than her. She slapped her so hard that her ears buzzed, and she almost fainted from the pain.
"Gu Liang."
Gu Liang, who was outside the door, stepped forward and said, "Master Hou."
"Consider it a reward from me and send them back." Zhou Yitian's tone was not warm at all.
Gu Liang knew that Zhou Yitian's implication was that he didn't want to see Zhao Xue in front of him again, so he immediately said yes and turned around to go out.
"My daughter, you are in trouble." Mrs. Song touched Zhao Xiaoya's face, her face full of distress.
She was indeed suffering, but looking at Mrs. Song, Zhao Xiaoya didn't want to say anything.
After all, Mrs. Song should be feeling more uncomfortable than she was.
Mrs. Song hugged her, feeling pain and reluctance in her heart. She quickly took Zhao Xiaoya's hand and said, "It's already this hour and we haven't passed on the meal yet. You must be hungry."
Before Zhao Xiaoya could speak, Zhou Yitian had already answered, "We used it in the Hou Mansion."
Mrs. Song was slightly stunned.
Zhao Xiaoya glanced at Zhou Yitian helplessly and said softly to Mrs. Song: "I have indeed used it, but I can still eat some with my mother and father."
Mrs. Song looked at each other excitedly with Mr. Wei Ge, said "good girl" in her mouth, and quickly ordered her servants to prepare the meal.
When Wei Yuanzhao heard Zhao Xiaoya calling her father and mother, he felt excited, "Xiaoya, I am my brother."
Zhou Yitian looked at Wei Yuanzhao expressionlessly.
Wei Yuanzhao deliberately turned a blind eye and looked at Zhao Xiaoya expectantly.
Zhao Xiaoya's survival instinct has always been very good. She has ignored Zhou Yitian's wishes and stayed in the Wei Mansion to eat. If she calls Wei Yuanzhao brother again, she is afraid that not only will she be unlucky, but Wei Yuanzhao will also not be easy off.
"Brother." She called out without being close or distant.
Although Wei Yuanzhao was dissatisfied, he could only accept it reluctantly. He looked at Zhou Yitian with displeasure, "You are so eager to marry Xiaoya because you are afraid that our Wei family will steal someone from you. You are really not a human being."
Zhou Yitian's response was just to glance at him arrogantly, showing no hint of guilt.
Mr. Wei Ge also realized something and looked at Zhou Yitian bitterly. His daughter had not lived at home for a day, so she became someone else's.
Noticing the angry look in Mr. Wei Ge's eyes, Zhou Yitian just called out, "Father-in-law."
Old Wei Ge was so angry that a mouthful of old blood stuck in his throat.
Zhou Yitian raised the corners of his lips. Although Mr. Wei Ge was not old-fashioned, he had a scholarly style after all. He knew very well that he would definitely not be the son-in-law choice in the minds of the Wei family, so he could only act first.
After eating, Zhou Yitian took his daughter away directly with the Song family's reluctance to leave her and the angry looks of Mr. Wei Ge and Wei Yuanzhao.
After all, my daughter is now married and belongs to the Zhou family. Even if she is unwilling to do so, she has no choice but to accept her.
Epilogue Good and evil will eventually be rewarded
After Zhou Yitian got married to Princess Yongle in Wei Yuanzhao, he left Beijing with food and returned to Mobei.
After sending Zhou Yitian away, Zhao Xiaoya still felt soft-hearted and went to the Wei Mansion to plead for Father Zhao.
Father Zhao was sent away from the capital. On the day he left, he received a sum of money sent by someone from Zhao Xiaoya, which made him burst into tears.
Liu Caifeng finally received the flogging, and she lost her voice before she was finished.
Zhao Xue ran away unwillingly on the way back to Guangzhou, but was caught by Aunt Li and beaten severely. She lay there for three days. When she woke up, she became deaf in both ears.
No matter how unwilling Zhao Xue is, she can only stay in the Li family and live her life obediently.
She didn't know that Zhou Yitian changed his mind because of her deafness, and she was lucky enough to survive.
The Wei Mansion did not involve Wei Zhaotong in this matter, but Elder Wei Ge still allowed him to return to the guard camp to train as he originally intended.
When Wei Zhaotong heard this, he was so angry that he immediately went to Mrs. Wei. Unexpectedly, what he faced was a burst of curses from Mrs. Wei. She had helped raise a child for no reason. This was a great shame to her.
Wei Zhaotong looked at Mrs. Wei's face, became angry for a moment, turned around and left home. Until this time, he had not realized that he was no longer the second son of the Wei family.
After all, Weige Lao Pingkong didn't hide the fact that he had a daughter, and the vicious Yi Zi incident spread throughout the capital in an instant.
All the people who usually called Wei Zhao brothers and sisters suddenly disappeared. Wei Zhao left the Wei Mansion together and drank to drown his sorrows every day. I only thought that one day he was drunk and staggering on the street. He saw the carriage of the Hou Mansion in a daze and shouted hurriedly, "Zhao Xiaoya, get out of here!"
Zhao Xiaoya, who was sitting in the carriage, originally wanted to ignore it, but Wei Zhaotong blocked the carriage regardless of life and death. Now the carriage was on the stone bridge, and she was in a dilemma, forcing her to get off the carriage.
Zhao Xiaoya looked around and was lost for a moment. She had also walked on this bridge, but in the end...
She looked at Wei Zhaotong, she was different, but what about him? Would you still choose the path of your previous life?
"Second Master blocked the road. I don't know why?"
Zhao Xiaoya's second master's voice was like a needle, piercing Wei Zhaotong's heart, causing him unbearable pain, "Zhao Xiaoya, no, I shouldn't call you Zhao Xiaoya now, I should call you Wei Xu. Xu, Nuanye, you are the sun of the Wei family, and I am the scum of the Wei family. You must be very proud, you will laugh in your dreams! You were originally a lowly child, but now you have turned into a noblewoman in the capital."
"Second Master is drunk." Zhao Xiaoya didn't look at him. She walked to the bridge and looked down at the flowing water below, "Go back."
Wei Zhaotong's face turned red. The frustration he had experienced these days, falling from the clouds to the dust, was all because of her. Without her, he would still be the second son of Mr. Wei Ge and the second master of the Wei family.
He suddenly reached out his hand to her and pushed her back.
Zhao Xiaoya was already on guard and dodged to the side.
Wei Zhaotong did not expect that she would dodge and fell into the water.
Xing'er's heartbeat skipped a beat and she quickly walked to Zhao Xiaoya's side. If there was any chance that Madam fell into the water, she would have no choice but to risk her life to answer to the Marquis.
Zhao Xiaoya looked at Wei Zhaotong who was floating and struggling in the water, murderous intent flashed in his eyes, and with a thought of good and evil, he finally called out
Angry, he didn't stop the groom from going to rescue people.
Zhao Xiaoya got on the carriage without looking back and sent someone to take Wei Zhaotong to the hospital. As for whether he would live or die in the future, she had nothing to say.
Zhou Yitian, who was far away in Mobei, looked at the sand table in front of him and listened to Gu Liang's words.
"Now Wei Zhaotong fell into the water and suffered from the cold, so he rented a shabby house to live in."
Zhou Yitian had no expression on his face. He placed the red flag of the Protectorate in his hand on the Tiele tribe outside the Pass and said lightly, "Since he is sick, let him get well."
Gu Liang understood the meaning behind this sentence and took the order to retreat.
Zhou Yitian's eyes stopped at the letter on the desk beside him. Thinking of Zhao Xiaoya's smile, there was a hint of guilt in his eyes.
Soon! He murmured in his heart: I will triumph, you can wait for me with peace of mind.
The next month, the army entered the Tiele tribe and the tribe surrendered.
After more than a year, the thirteen tribes in Mobei surrendered, and Zhou Yitian led the army back to Beijing in triumph.
Zhao Xiaoya saw the familiar tall figure and showed a familiar smile.
He looked into her eyes and said, "I'm back."
She ran into his arms and he held her tightly.
A glance that lasted ten thousand years, and the one that would haunt his heart for the rest of his life was none other than her.
